sections.title: Bottom line
sections.explainer: charityevals' step, not Ambitious Impact's: its bottom line per dollar, in the site's units.

rows.label: Discount rate
rows.explainer: Ambitious Impact discounts at 0.04 a year. Linked to the shared discount rate (Your values); the evaluator view pins it to Ambitious Impact's rate.

rows.label: Fixed charity costs
rows.explainer: Fixed costs of starting the charity

rows.label: Charity cost (Expected)
Calculation - proportion in Country X (row 37)
rows.explainer: Calculated in the source sheet as `=if(B37+1<=$B$14+$B$24, B37+1, "-")`; kept as a fixed number here (text in arithmetic).

rows.label: Time taken to introduce regulation
rows.explainer: Assume this will take 5 years; see main report for full explanation

rows.label: Ongoing charity costs
rows.explainer: Costs based roughly on three staff members. After conversation with IPEN and GiveWell's conversation notes with IPEN, it could likely be run on a lower budget, but we've assumed higher amount to be consistent with our other reports.

rows.label: Stopping point if charity is unsuccessful
rows.explainer: If after 5 years it looks unlikely the charity will be successful, we assume they will end the operation. Costs after this point will therefore be incurred probabilistically.

rows.label: Charity years operating
rows.explainer: Implementation period - from WHO CEA guidelines: https://www.who.int/choice/publications/p_2003_generalised_cea.pdf

rows.label: Reduced ongoing charity costs
Counterfactual impact
rows.explainer: We assume 100% for this input, as we have made an adjustment for the counterfactual impact of the organization in the 'Years policy brought forward' input

rows.label: Probability of success
rows.explainer: The probability that regulation will be introduced. Probability assumed relatively high because of historic successes and support from IPEN. See main report for further discussion.

summary: Ambitious Impact's 2020 estimate for a new charity advocating for lead paint regulation in a typical Sub-Saharan African country, counting health and income gains from lower childhood lead exposure. The idea the Lead Exposure Elimination Project was founded to run. A re-implementation of the sheet's point-estimate tab ($204 per DALY equivalent); the report's headline of about $156 is the mean of a Monte Carlo simulation whose draws are pasted into the sheet.
